name: Escape Jail Obby 2
desc:
Fan of the game? Join here! https://www.roblox.com/communities/2822047

A roblox classic from 2014!

At last the long-awaited sequel to the roblox classic Escape Jail Obby is finally here! Work your way through 10 all new stages plus the signature Extra Credit Obby! This game supports a custom made hint feature, intricate coin system, and much more!
